title: currentRefinedValues adds empty div
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛** The currentRefinedValues widget renders html that contains a seemingly useless div. This makes it impossible to style the element following BEM, as I also cannot assign a class to this element trough cssClasses. I was mostly wondering if there is a reason for this div to exist? See the generated html here, the imo dubious element is the third: ```html
≤ 5 0
Clear all
``` **To Reproduce 🔍** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Generate an instance of currentRefinedValues 2. Activate some filter 3. See the div **Expected behavior 💭** Clean html with no empty/unnamed divs **Environment:** - Browser (Chrome) - Version 2.10.1

comments.body:
Wow, I wasn't aware of `display: contents` yet, that's nice, thanks! Still, it's a patch of course, and needs a polyfill, and I just like clean html😭, but this should work.

[I've made a tiny proposal](https://github.com/jasperkennis/instantsearch.js/tree/move-body-class-on-current-refined-values) for moving the class one layer deeper but I suppose that too counts as a patch, and would be a major change to incorporate anyway.

Out of curiosity, can I see that list you're referring to?

That patch looks good, and would indeed be the way to go. The list isn’t public, but if you send me an email (haroen@algolia.com), I can give you access to see it, since you’re interested. 

I’ll close this issue now, since it’s not _too_ big of a problem, and you have your patch as a change, as well as the issue will be resolved when we do this widget rewrite. 

Feel free to comment further though.
